releases.name: 3.0.1 — enforced candidate menu, per-source chains, comparing gate
releases.notes:
## What changed

3.0.1 closes the gap between what the README promised and what the code enforced. The short version: a Go model id can no longer be invented, chain length follows the source, Markdown agents can actually be written, the mode question is asked once, and `check` re-derives the numbers instead of trusting the file.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#301---2026-11-03) for the full list. The Chinese changelog is at [zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md).

## Install this release

Download **`opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip`** below. It is the minimal package, not the GitHub "source code" archive:

- top-level directory is `opencode-go-model-picker/`
- it contains only `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `scripts/` and `LICENSE` — no tests, no docs site, no `assets/`, no `.git`, no `node_modules`
- 18 files

Extract it into your OpenCode skills directory so the folder name matches the skill name:

```bash
unzip opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip -d ~/.config/opencode/skills/
```

```powershell
Expand-Archive opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip -DestinationPath "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode\skills"
```

Then ask OpenCode to check your agent models. The skill is read-only until you confirm a diff.

en.headline: 48 commits across four repositories, plus 6 automated commits
en.summary: **48 commits** were recorded across four repositories, with 6 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, 17 own commits added multilingual glyph variants, background textures, a Python API, expanded presets, semantic modes, typography controls, PNG/SVG output, batch and JSON results, rewritten documentation, and CI workflows. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 15 own commits added the `starlight-docs` skill scaffold and templates, documented external-link check results, fixed mobile theme and language controls, and graded link failures to avoid proxy or offline false positives. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 10 own commits updated agent roles and routing for version 3.0.6, added Mermaid and Excalidraw diagrams, documented V2 skill discovery and orchestration, and recorded user-measured AI-detection results changing from 40% to 0.x%. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`, 6 own commits enforced candidate menus, per-source chains, and a fail-closed comparing gate, then released `v3.0.1`. No pull requests, issues, reviews, or discussions were recorded.

releaseNotes.summary: The release prevents invented Go model IDs, derives chain length from each source, allows Markdown agents to be written, asks the mode question once, and makes `check` re-derive values instead of trusting the file.

zh.headline: 四个仓库共 48 次提交，另有 6 次自动提交
zh.summary: 当天在四个仓库记录了 **48 次提交**，另有 6 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 的 17 次本人提交加入多语言字形变体、背景纹理、Python API、扩充的风格预设、语义化模式、排版参数、PNG/SVG 输出、批量与 JSON 结果，并重写文档和添加 CI 工作流。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 15 次本人提交新增 `starlight-docs` 脚本骨架与模板资源，记录外链检查实测结果，修复手机端主题与语言控件，并按失败原因分级以避免代理或离线误报。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 10 次本人提交按 3.0.6 更新角色名册与路由，补充 Mermaid 和 Excalidraw 图，记录 V2 技能发现与主从代理编排，并收录用户实测的降 AI 检测结果从 40% 变为 0.x%。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 的 6 次本人提交落实候选菜单、按来源链和失败即拦截的比较检查，并发布 `v3.0.1`。当天没有 pull request、issue、review 或讨论记录。

releaseNotes.summary: 该版本禁止虚构 Go 模型 ID，按来源确定链长度，允许编写 Markdown agent，只询问一次模式问题，并让 `check` 重新推导数值而不再直接信任文件。
